items.name: date-input
items.title: Date input
items.description: Native date, datetime-local, month, week and time input in the YoRHa control surface (type, min/max/step) inside a Field, with an end button that opens the kit Calendar, week Calendar, MonthPicker, TimePicker or Calendar + TimePicker in the Popover (native picker on coarse pointers).
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Built on Base UI; ornaments are drawn with CSS only. Pick the control with `type` (date, datetime-local, month, week, time); values use the native formats. `picker` adds a calendar button for type=date only; Escape or picking a day closes the popup and returns focus to the button. min and max also disable days in the calendar. Set lang on the wrapper for CJK leading. v3 BREAKING: the input and an end button share one InputGroup frame; the native picker indicator is hidden for every type and the end button shows CalendarIcon (ClockIcon for type=time) and calls showPicker(); with `picker` and type=date it opens the kit Calendar anchored below the field. The button now exists for every type (name `달력 열기`, `시간 선택` for time; pickerLabel overrides). The native control's segment order and month/weekday words follow the browser UI locale, not `lang`: use DatePicker when the text must be Korean. v4: (V4-245) the focused segment is an ink block with on-ink text (Chromium/Safari `::-webkit-datetime-edit-*-field:focus`), numerals tabular; Firefox draws its own segment highlight. (V4-246) BREAKING: `picker` is `auto | calendar | native` and defaults to `auto`: type=date opens the kit Calendar on fine pointers and the native picker on coarse pointers (`true`/`false` still work as calendar/native). The control inherits `color-scheme` from the theme so any UA popup follows light/dark. (V4-248) form `reset` restores defaultValue. Native date inputs differ per browser (V4-254): Chromium shows year/month/day segments with a locale-ordered text and its own popup; Safari desktop has segments but no popup for some types; iOS/Android use OS wheels and pickers; Firefox shows a different segment highlight and its own popup. v4 (V4-252, V4-253) BREAKING, migration: with a mouse or trackpad (`(pointer: fine)`, `picker="auto"`) every type now opens a kit picker in the Popover instead of the OS popup, so week, month, time and datetime-local no longer show the browser's white native popup; coarse pointers (phones, tablets) and `picker="native"` keep `showPicker()`. week: Calendar in week mode (ISO 8601, Monday start, ISO week-year, `주` column, the whole row is one band, any day picks its week, ArrowUp/Down by week, PageUp/Down by month, footer `이번 주` / `지우기`). month: MonthPicker (year header with previous/next year, 3 x 4 grid, roving arrows, footer `이번 달` / `지우기`). time: TimePicker (hour and minute listboxes of fixed height, a seconds column when `step` < 60, minute step from `step`, ArrowUp/Down inside a column, ArrowLeft/Right or Tab between columns, Enter or `확인` commits, footer `지금` / `지우기`). datetime-local: Calendar and TimePicker side by side (stacked under 420px), one commit with `확인`. Picking writes the exact native value format into the input and dispatches `input` and `change`, so forms, validation and reset keep working; min, max and step disable days, months, weeks and time options; Escape closes and focus returns to the button; the field never changes size. The native input sets `color-scheme` per theme so a remaining UA popup (coarse pointer) follows light/dark. The pickers are files of this item (`month-picker.tsx`, `time-picker.tsx`: `MonthPicker`, `TimePicker`, `PickerFooter`) and need `@yorha/button`; Calendar gained `weekMode`, `onToday`, `onClear` and the labels `week`, `clear` (all optional, default off).
